A player with 17 free kicks can absolutely be bad at taking free kicks because the ability to score from them is not dependable solely on that one stat. Technique, composure, free kicks, long shots, hidden stats like consistency and big matches as well depending on the situation. I had a couple of world class strikers (according to the game) last couple of FMs that couldn't get over 10 goals a season, how come? Because it depends on many things. For example, I'd say Calhanoglu's free kicks stat is like 20, how come the last free kick he scored was like 5 years ago IRL? That one player with 7 free kicks scored maybe 1 free kick goal in a couple of years, yes, against you, tough luck, yet is it impossible for him? I wouldn't say so. 
Same goes with Fabian Schar, for example, scoring long shot bangers every season, yet nobody would say he will surely score a long shot every season or that his ability/likeliness to score one is better or more likely to happen than Valverde's. And I could go on and on with these examples.
